skills.skill_name: Four Stages of AI Adoption Framework
skills.description: A progression model for AI adoption: Stage 1 (chatting/prompting) → Stage 2 (packaging into reusable skills) → Stage 3 (delegating tasks to AI workers) → Stage 4 (orchestrating AI systems). Most users are stuck at Stage 1; Stage 2 (skills) unlocks the real value.

Stage 4 (orchestration) = multiple AI workers running skills in parallel, each specialized.
general_tips: 90% of people are stuck at Stage 1 — the jump to packaging skills is the single highest-leverage transition.
Think of AI stages as levels: prompting → skills → delegation → orchestration. Identify your current level and work on advancing one level at a time.

popularity_signals: 90% of people are stuck on stage one
